links.outcome: Clinician comprehension of diabetes prediction process, data, features and feature importance after using explanations
links.effect: Reported substantial improvement in medical professionals' comprehension of the prediction process, training data sets, features used and feature importance; most reported heightened understanding and trust. No numbers in abstract.
links.quote: The evaluation study findings underscore the substantial improvement in medical professionals' comprehension of key aspects, including the (1) diabetes prediction process, (2) data sets used for model training, (3) data features used, and (4) relative significance of different features in prediction outcomes.

screen.reason: The study empirically tests an explainability interface (XAI) deployment feature with healthcare professionals using a survey-based user study on patient scenarios, measuring its impact on user comprehension and trust.
